La Torre Eiffel continúa rodeada de cientos de turistas que buscan la pose perfecta. En Notre-Dame, las colas para entrar siguen llenando la plaza de Jean-Paul. Y, por todos lados, se puede ver a grupos de turistas que siguen como hormiguitas a la hormiga reina (el guía), quien lleva una banderita de color por si alguna se pierde. item.title: Tommy Robinson tells court he had photos taken of journalists’ homes to pressure them
item.description: Far-right activist says he used private investigators to track down journalists but denies trying to intimidate them The far-right activist Tommy Robinson has told his harassment trial that he used private investigators to track down journalists who had written about his alleged role in the 2024 riots, and had photographs taken of their homes “to put pressure” on them. Robinson, whose real name is Stephen Yaxley-Lennon, denied in court that his actions, which included sharing photos of the wife and daughter of one of the journalists, were designed to intimidate and bully. item.title: Amazon loses 240 million acres of forest, risking rainfall disruption
item.description: According to a recent report, the Amazon has lost 97 million hectares of primary forest by 2025. A strong El Niño expected in late 2026 could exacerbate these issues and increase fire risks. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Garrett Brown launched Cameron Ranch Glamping on a picturesque 10-acre plot in Houston, beginning with a minimal budget. The business flourished initially with a geodome, later evolving through zero-cost revenue-sharing arrangements.
